name: BeReal
description: BeReal is a mobile social network for daily front-and-back-camera posts, friends, reactions, comments, messages, Memories, and audience-controlled sharing.
agentUseSummary: BeReal is unavailable as a Relay connection. BeReal publishes no supported third-party developer API or delegated authorization contract, and its current Terms of Service explicitly state that its services must not be used by AIs or bots. Relay will not reverse-engineer the mobile service, capture a phone or SMS session, automate the app, or access BeReal content.

blocked.label: Connect BeReal
blocked.description: No connection is exposed because BeReal publishes no third-party API and expressly prohibits AI or bot use of its services.

blocked.label: Collect BeReal credentials
blocked.description: Phone numbers, SMS verification codes, passwords, session tokens, device identifiers, cookies, and private request material are never collected.

blocked.label: Read BeReal data
blocked.description: Profiles, friends, contacts, posts, feeds, photos, locations, comments, RealMojis, messages, Memories, notifications, and account metadata remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change BeReal or use private interfaces
blocked.description: Posting, reacting, commenting, messaging, friending, deleting, changing audiences, private API calls, scraping, app or device automation, arbitrary endpoints, and raw responses are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No BeReal action or credential path is exposed.

providerSetup.blocker: BeReal's current public materials provide mobile-app and help-center user workflows, not a developer platform, API, OAuth client registration, delegated scopes, webhooks, or third-party data contract. Its Terms of Service, updated June 30, 2026, explicitly state that the services must not be used by AIs or bots. Private mobile endpoints, telephone and SMS sessions, and UI automation would violate the supported boundary and create unacceptable access to friends-only content.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep BeReal unavailable. Reconsider only if BeReal publishes an official third-party developer program whose terms expressly permit agent use, with delegated least-authority authorization, documented endpoints, review and revocation. Do not use private mobile APIs, captured sessions, scraping, browser or device automation, or account credentials.

evidence.supports: BeReal's Terms of Service, updated June 30, 2026, define its apps, websites and supporting systems as the services and expressly state that the services must not be used by AIs or bots.
BeReal documents posting as a person-operated mobile-camera workflow with daily notification, front and back cameras, retakes, timing and audience choices.
BeReal documents user-controlled friends-only and friends-of-friends post audiences, establishing sensitive social content that Relay cannot infer authority to access.
BeReal documents account deletion through the mobile app or a dedicated user request form, not a third-party delegated account API.
